sculptor.match: Match each sculpture to the sculptor who made it.

rows.label: David
rows.hook: depicts a biblical shepherd about to face a giant, carved from a single block of marble

rows.label: Pietà
rows.hook: depicts a grieving mother cradling her son's body after his crucifixion

rows.label: The Sphere
rows.hook: was heavily damaged when the towers behind it collapsed and now stands as a memorial nearby

rows.label: Trevi Fountain
rows.hook: is where visitors toss a coin over their shoulder to guarantee a return trip to the city

rows.label: Cloud Gate
rows.description: public art sculpture in Chicago, Illinois, United States
rows.hook: reflects the city skyline in its mirror-like steel surface and is nicknamed for its bean-like shape

rows.label: The Rape of Proserpina
rows.hook: shows the god of the underworld carrying off a young goddess to make her his queen

rows.label: Comedian
rows.hook: is a piece of fruit duct-taped to a wall that someone later ate as a performance

rows.label: Manneken Pis
rows.description: bronze sculpture and fountain by Jérôme Duquesnoy the Elder in Brussels, Belgium
rows.hook: is a small bronze fountain figure of a boy relieving himself, often dressed up for local events

rows.label: Fountain
rows.description: readymade sculpture attributed to Marcel Duchamp consisting of a porcelain urinal signed "R. Mutt 1917"
rows.hook: is a signed porcelain urinal that challenged what counts as a work of art

rows.label: Kryptos
rows.description: encrypted sculpture by American artist Jim Sanborn
rows.hook: carries four encoded messages outside an intelligence agency's headquarters, one of them still unsolved

rows.label: Golden Rider
rows.hook: shows a gilded ruler on horseback overlooking a city street in Germany

rows.label: Jules Rimet Trophy
rows.description: original prize for winning the FIFA World Cup
rows.hook: was the original prize given to the winner of international football's biggest tournament, until it was stolen

rows.label: The Veiled Virgin
rows.hook: shows a face beneath a carved veil so thin it looks almost see-through

rows.label: Ecstasy of Saint Teresa
rows.hook: shows a nun in a swoon of religious rapture as an angel looks on beside her

rows.label: The Kelpies
rows.hook: consists of two towering steel horse heads inspired by mythical water spirits

rows.label: Charging Bull
rows.hook: is a bronze animal near a financial district symbolizing an aggressive, optimistic market

rows.label: The Endless Column
rows.hook: stacks rhomboid modules into a tall memorial honoring fallen soldiers

rows.label: Homunculus Loxodontus
rows.description: 2016 sculpture by Margriet van Breevoort and an Internet meme
rows.hook: is a tiny sculpted creature resembling a miniature elephant that became a viral internet meme

rows.label: Madonna of Bruges
rows.hook: was its sculptor's only finished work to leave Italy in his lifetime and now sits in a Belgian church

rows.label: Veiled Christ
rows.hook: lies beneath a carved shroud so delicate it seems to reveal the body underneath, in a chapel in Naples

rows.label: Bust of Queen Nefertiti
rows.description: bust from the Amarna Period in the Neues Museum, Berlin
rows.hook: is missing one eye's inlay and has become an icon of ancient feminine beauty

rows.label: Moses
rows.hook: has small horns on its head stemming from a famous mistranslation of a Hebrew word
